user.title: Set up Reliable Notify
user.description: **New notification targets and people:** Open [Reliable Notify – target management](/reliable-notify) in the sidebar → **Targets & people** → **Add target** or **Add person**. Target management is visible to administrators only. This dialog configures integration operation. The default target is optional.

init.title: Settings
init.description: **New notification targets and people:** Open [Reliable Notify – target management](/reliable-notify) in the sidebar → **Targets & people** → **Add target** or **Add person**. Target management is visible to administrators only. This dialog configures integration operation. The default target is optional. All sections are expanded. The optional YAML preview appears before saving.

data_description.target_entity: Optional fallback, not a new notification target. Create targets in the Reliable Notify sidebar panel.

error.invalid_options: Invalid settings: check numeric ranges, times and retry delays.

enqueue.name: Queue notification
enqueue.description: Persist a notification for explicit recipients or transport; without recipients/default it stays staged for manual review (no push is sent).

recipients.name: Recipients
recipients.description: Named person, channel or group from reliable_notify_routes.yaml (list or string).

media.name: Media type
media.description: For Telegram recipients, photo changes send_message to send_photo; other transports retain their normal message.

action.name: HA action
action.description: Optional direct transport action (omit when using recipients).

data.name: Transport parameters
data.description: Transport parameters such as Telegram target, inline_keyboard, file or url.

message_type.name: Message type
message_type.description: Archive category, such as windows, pvec, security, or default priority.

archive.name: Archiving
archive.description: Keep in archive, or delete immediately after successful delivery.

archive_days.name: Retention (days)
archive_days.description: Explicit retention override in days. Zero deletes after successful delivery.

acknowledgement.name: Acknowledgement and escalation
acknowledgement.description: Optional acknowledgement (required: true, escalation: list) with dedup_key; uses an explicit acknowledge action.

only_if.name: State condition
only_if.description: Optional current HA entity-state guard; suppress the notification before delivery if the state no longer matches (for example a closed window).

test_mode.name: Test mode
test_mode.description: Force local staging for this notification, with no delivery or escalation.

retry_all.name: Retry waiting messages
retry_all.description: Schedule queued notifications for immediate retry.

retry_dead.name: Retry dead letters
retry_dead.description: Return failed messages to the active queue (may cause duplicates).

cancel.name: Cancel waiting messages
cancel.description: Cancel waiting notifications matching a deduplication key.

reload_routes.name: Reload people and groups
reload_routes.description: Validate and reload /config/reliable_notify_routes.yaml without restarting HA.

retry_one.name: Retry a single queued notification

dead.name: From dead-letter queue
dead.description: True to restore from the dead-letter queue.

retry_one.description: Schedule a single queued or failed notification for retry.

delete_one.name: Delete one queued notification

dead.name: From dead-letter queue
dead.description: True to delete a dead-letter message.

delete_one.description: Delete a single queued or failed notification.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge pending alert
acknowledge.description: Mark a deduplication key as acknowledged and stop further escalations.

update.name: Replace waiting notification
update.description: Replace queued notifications sharing dedup_key, with a new message and explicit recipients.

dismiss.name: Dismiss Companion App notification
dismiss.description: Cancel pending notifications and enqueue clear_notification commands by deterministic tag.

simulate.name: Simulate routing (no delivery)
simulate.description: Read-only preview of recipients, priorities, quiet hours and archive lifetime. Does not write SQLite or send pushes. Requires response_variable.

backup.name: Create consistent SQLite backup
backup.description: Admin-only online SQLite snapshot with integrity check. Requires response_variable. Retains configured number of prior snapshots.

send_template.name: Send a stored Reliable Notify template
send_template.description: Render an admin-configured message template and enqueue it through Reliable Notify. The template name must exist in the admin panel.

recipients.name: Recipients
recipients.description: Named recipients, people or groups; overrides template defaults.

telegram_lifecycle.name: Edit or delete an already sent Telegram notification
telegram_lifecycle.description: Edit/delete the most recent known Telegram message matching a deduplication key and explicitly configured chat. This calls Telegram directly and does not use retry queue.

message.name: Message
message.description: New body required for edit operation.
